### 具體操作示例

```python
# ① 與航空公司取得報價（假設返回值為 $5,200）
flight_info = get_flight_cost(
    travel_from="SFO",
    travel_to="FCO",
    travel_date="2024-10-10",
    travel_class="business"
)

usd_price = flight_info["price_usd"]   # 假設這裡會得到 5200

# ② 匯率計算（以當前市場匯率為例）
exchange_result = compute_exchange_rate(
    base_currency="USD",
    target_currency="EUR",
    value=usd_price
)

```

#### 信用卡餘額核對範例

```python
balance_check = get_credit_card_balance(
    access_token="abc123xyz",
    card_id="card_7243"
)
